# Oscar Highlights Tailored New Health Products in Florida for 2027 Open Enrollment


November 17, 2026 6:06pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f119d0efa9f2a8b730aba153ee9eb9f9/hioscar/news/2026-11-17_Oscar_Highlights_Tailored_New_Health_Products_in_232.pdf)


*RetireEase plan bridges gap ahead of Medicare*


*New partnerships expand access, convenience, and protection*


MIAMI--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Oscar](http://www.hioscar.com/?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) , one of the fastest-growing insurers in the individual market and part of[Oscar Health](http://www.oscarhealth.com/) (NYSE: OSCR), highlights new additions to its health plan lineup available to Florida individuals, families, and businesses for 2027 Open Enrollment1.


“Floridians deserve health coverage that is straightforward, affordable and built for every stage of life,” said Matt Choffin, Florida Market President for Oscar. “Our research shows that seven-in-ten Floridians feel more confident choosing coverage when it reflects their individual needs. Oscar offers plans designed around the life stages, health needs and budgets of the people we serve, with predictable costs, personalized support and tools that make it easier to get the care they need.”


**More personalized options for Floridians**[RetireEase](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/retire-ease?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) joins Oscar’s growing portfolio of health plans tailored to life stage, clinical, cultural, and work needs, that deliver 15 to 25% in savings2 *.* The plan makes the move from early retirement to Medicare easier, empowering early retirees to protect their savings with coverage built around their current needs. For people leaving employer coverage, *RetireEase* may be a more affordable alternative. Members can keep their trusted doctors and pay transparent, set prices for preventive visits, lab work, physical therapy, heart care, and bone-and-joint care.


For eligible Florida residents, plan features include:


- **Predictable costs:** Fixed copays from $0 to $35 for primary care, lab work, physical therapy and other routine services; and fixed copays of $75 to $100 for cardiology and orthopedic care.
- **$0 generic prescriptions:** Access to $0 generic medications.
- **Personalized guidance:** Oscar Care Guides to help members understand benefits and find care.
- **Digital support:** Every Oscar member has access to[Oswell](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/meet-oswell?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) , Oscar’s everyday AI health guide, which helps clarify health care questions and next steps3.


Other personalized options for Floridians include[HelloMeno](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/hellomeno?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) , which provides a $0 package of menopause treatments, scans, and screenings, as well as other plans providing tailored coverage for members living with[diabetes](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/diabetes-care?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) ,[COPD, asthma](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/asthma-copd?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) , and[cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/chronic-care-ckm?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) 4. Oscar is also introducing new plans with[dental and vision coverage](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-vision-dental?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) automatically included, with $0 preventive dental checkups, $0 eye exams, and discounted vision benefits.5


Oscar’s network in Florida includes major provider and hospital system partners throughout the state, including Advent Health, Ascension Health, Baptist Health South Florida, Broward Health, HCA Healthcare, Jackson Health System, Larkin Health System, Memorial Healthcare, Orlando Health, Tampa General Hospital, and the University of Miami. Anyone shopping for coverage should confirm their preferred doctor and healthcare system are part of the plan network before enrolling for 2027 coverage.


**New in 2027: Sanitas Medical Center** Starting Jan. 1, 2027,[Sanitas Medical Centers](https://www.mysanitas.com/en/fl) will join Oscar’s provider network. This partnership brings affordable, compassionate, and personalized care directly to members across 50 Florida locations. Rooted deeply in the community with proven experience in value based care, this collaboration pairs comprehensive clinical services and an experienced multidisciplinary care team with clear, easy-to-use digital tools to empower patients through every stage of life.


**Affordable bundles, added financial protection** Open Enrollment gives Floridians an opportunity to reassess their health care needs and choose plans that support both everyday care and unexpected moments. Two-in-five (38%) Floridians also report that an unforeseen medical bill after an unexpected event can hurt as much as the event itself.


In response, Oscar partnered with[Allstate Health Solutions](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/supplemental-plans?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) to add supplemental cash-pay options to any Oscar plan in Florida. These low-cost options can help cover medical bills from accidents, serious illnesses, or hospital stays.


**CHOICE empowers Florida workers** Workers whose employers offer a CHOICE Arrangement (formerly ICHRA) can use their monthly contribution to help pay for their individual coverage. CHOICE allows employers to offer competitive benefits with clear, predictable budgets. Employees are empowered with tax-free contributions to easily choose the best plan for them and trusted CHOICE administrators simplify the transition and implementation process.


Employers can enroll their teams at[hioscar.com/for-employers](https://www.hioscar.com/for-employers?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) , or through their broker.


Individuals, families, and employees can sign up for Oscar’s health plans starting Nov. 1, 2026, with coverage beginning on Jan. 1, 2027 by visiting[Healthcare.gov](http://healthcare.gov/) , calling 1-855-672-2788, or speaking with an insurance agent. Anyone shopping for coverage should confirm that their preferred doctor and healthcare system are part of the plan network before enrolling for the upcoming year.


**About Oscar Insurance** Oscar Insurance is one of the largest and fastest-growing health insurers dedicated to the individual market. Oscar serves millions of individuals across the country with innovative products and CHOICE Arrangement solutions (formerly ICHRA) tailored to their life stages, health needs, and budgets. Oscar technology-powered experiences make high-quality care easy to use and feel personal. Oscar is part of Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR). Learn more at[HiOscar.com](https://www.hioscar.com/?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-fl&utm_medium=florida_all_null&utm_term=regional) .
